main_candidate.method: Parallel two-step Rosenbrock-W methods: distinguish common-shift parallel two-step W from multi-implicit peer two-step W; compare both to sequential high-stage-order peer controls.
main_candidate.rationale: A new method can make current stages independent by using previous-step peer data; this is preferable to claiming that the lower-triangular stages of original RODAS5P are independent.

candidates.target: s=6, stage order q=s, global order p=s on variable-step grids only within the verified ratio domain
candidates.parallel_condition: same-step lower-triangular couplings tilde-A=tilde-Gamma=0. Then all current stages use previous-step data only and share one shifted matrix I-h*gamma*T_m.
candidates.benefit: One LU/factorization per step with s independent RHS; strongest common-factor/multiple-RHS reuse candidate.
candidates.caveat: s=6 table and step-ratio/stability range must come from the paper or be constructed from its exact order/stability equations; not assumed available.

candidates.target: s=8, global order p=s-1=7 on admissible variable-step sequences; investigate p=s only if exact stronger conditions preserve stage independence and stability
candidates.parallel_condition: all same-step coupling terms vanish; independent current stages
candidates.benefit: Higher available degree of method parallelism and literature-reported parallel methods up to order 7.
candidates.caveat: Retrieve an actual s=8 coefficient set and its zero-stability/step-ratio region; literature result 'up to order 7' does not automatically identify s=8.

candidates.target: s=6 and s=8 order s-1 candidates, with stage-dependent implicit parameters
candidates.stage_equations: Stage i depends only on peer data from step m-1; each stage has its own shifted operator (I-h_m*gamma_i*T_m) or source-defined equivalent.
candidates.parallel_condition: all stage equations use prior-step peer variables only; different stage linear systems are independent and may be solved simultaneously.
candidates.benefit: Stage-specific damping parameters and parallel Krylov solves; shared-shift factorization is not assumed.
candidates.caveat: Measure total work across independent/block/multi-shift Krylov strategies, distinct preconditioners and memory. Exact tableau and realistic stepsize-ratio stability theorem are prerequisites.

candidates.target: stage-order s-1, variable-step zero-stable and L(alpha)-stable published candidates
candidates.role: High-stage-order stiff-accuracy/order-reduction control, not automatically admitted as a stage-parallel method.
candidates.parallel_condition: Only admit if the actual selected coefficient matrix for current-step coupling is diagonal (or has proven independent blocks); lower-triangular same-step coupling means sequential stages.
candidates.caveat: Constant-step effective order s must not be conflated with variable-step global order.

candidates.family: stiffly accurate two-step W with added variable-step superconvergence condition
candidates.target: Explore order p*=s+1 as a nonparallel accuracy/control point
candidates.role: Pareto comparator for the cost of imposing stronger variable-step order conditions.
candidates.parallel_condition: Do not presume independent stages. The cited construction reports that the additional condition destroys stage parallelism.
candidates.caveat: May be useful as a low-step-count sequential comparator, not as primary CPU stage-parallel candidate.

schematic_equations: Y_ni = U_n + h_n sum_j a_ij U_(n-1,j) + h_n sum_(j<i) a_tilde_ij U_(n,j)
(I-gamma*h_n*T_n) U_ni = F(Y_ni) + h_n*T_n sum_j gamma_ij U_(n-1,j) + h_n*T_n sum_(j<i) gamma_tilde_ij U_(n,j)
U_(n+1) = U_n + h_n sum_i (b_i U_ni + v_i U_(n-1,i))
Current stages are independent when same-step couplings a_tilde_ij and gamma_tilde_ij vanish; confirm exact notation from primary coefficient source.
acceptance: Exact coefficient table and primary source pinned by paper version, URL, source hash and method identity.
Prove stage independence from actual coefficient matrices; concurrency instrumentation must show overlap on a real ODE.
Verify general-step order and zero-stability for the entire declared step-ratio interval, not just constant h.
Verify stiff stability/damping on negative real and complex sectors, nonnormal systems and Prothero-Robinson/MOL tests.
Startup produces all required peer data to matching order; rollback/restart after rejection, events and discontinuities is consistent.
At least seven randomized paired full-IVP CPU timings at matched achieved error.
Research target: accepted steps <=1.10x protected RODAS5P and median full-IVP CPU speedup >=1.15x on a preregistered subset; preserve a failure if unmet.
main_candidate.fallback: Protected RODAS5P; peer-W remains opt-in or is rejected.

required_work: Recover original full method equations and exact coefficient tables for parallel two-step W, multi-implicit peer two-step W and sequential Rosenbrock-type peer families. Treat them as distinct method identities.

For common-shift TSW derive conditions tilde-A=tilde-Gamma=0 from the selected exact equations; verify every stage RHS depends on previous-step values only and that one shifted operator is genuinely shared.
For multi-implicit peer-W recover stage-specific shifts and derive stagewise order/stability; compare independent Krylov, shared-basis/multi-shift Krylov and reusable preconditioners.

Verify variable-step order, stage order, zero-stability, L(alpha)-stability, amplification matrix bounds over realistic step-ratio intervals, startup and embedded estimator. Recover the 2011 published local/global peer-W error estimator before considering new estimator design.
Assess the stronger stiffly accurate p*=s+1 construction as a sequential control; quantify the loss of stage concurrency rather than quietly removing the stronger condition.
Extend existing ParallelExecution and stage_batch with the real selected tableau; no second executor or benchmark framework.
Use the existing LinearOperator, LinearSolverConfig, LU/Krylov and preconditioner services; no new Krylov solver before current APIs are audited.
Integrate as a distinct plugin via existing vigilode Problem/session after V11-03/05/08; preserve protected RODAS5P.
Run >=7 randomized paired full-IVP CPU timings at matched achieved output error, including peer startup, rejected trials and step-ratio transitions.

parallel_two_step_W.predictor: Y_mi = u_m + h_m*sum_{j=1}^s a_ij*k_(m-1,j) + h_m*sum_{j=1}^{i-1} tilde_a_ij*k_(m,j)
parallel_two_step_W.solve: (I-h_m*gamma*T_m) k_(m,i) = f(t_mi,Y_mi) + h_m*T_m*sum_{j=1}^s Gamma_ij*k_(m-1,j) + h_m*T_m*sum_{j=1}^{i-1} tilde_Gamma_ij*k_(m,j)
parallel_two_step_W.independence: tilde_A=0 and tilde_Gamma=0. The current stages then use previous-step data only and share the common shifted matrix I-h*gamma*T_m.
parallel_two_step_W.order_contract: Stage order q is defined by C(q),Gamma(q); output order p by B(p); convergence order p*=min(q+1,p) under bounded step-ratio and compatible start errors. q=p=s gives the order-s design target.

multi_implicit_peer_two_step_W.independence: All current peer stages use only previous-step peer data.
multi_implicit_peer_two_step_W.shifts: Different stage system parameters may give different shifted linear systems. Do not assume one common LU across the stages.
multi_implicit_peer_two_step_W.order_stability: Published subclass order s-1 with optimal stiff damping and uniform stability for realistic step-size sequences; exact operational step-ratio interval and coefficients must be fetched.

implicit_parallel_peer.independence: Current peer nonlinear equations can be computed independently from previous-step peer values.
implicit_parallel_peer.warning: Nonlinear solve work must be charged; candidate only if linearly implicit W tables fail the stability/accuracy tradeoff.

sequential_peer_control.form: Peer representation with lower-triangular current-stage G. Stages are sequential unless the chosen G is diagonal/block-independent.
sequential_peer_control.warning: Constant-step effective order s is not variable-step global order.

stiff_accurate_nonparallel_control.property: An added variable-step superconvergence condition can yield p*=s+1 but the cited construction loses stage parallelism.
stiff_accurate_nonparallel_control.role: Sequential Pareto control, not main parallel candidate.

error_estimation_source.citation: Kulikov & Weiner (2011), Global error estimation and control in linearly-implicit parallel two-step peer W-methods
error_estimation_source.reuse_policy: First recover and validate the published local/global error estimators and automatic step-size algorithm for the selected tableau. Do not design a new estimator from scratch unless the existing theorem is incompatible with the selected method.
error_estimation_source.caveat: The publication's estimator is not automatically valid for a different coefficient table; rederive compatibility and source the exact estimator equations.

transform_candidate.method: Finite resonant Poincare-Dulac normal-form lift to a linear parent system on an invariant algebraic manifold.
transform_candidate.scope: Local analytic/polynomial flow near a stable hyperbolic equilibrium only.
construction: x_dot=A*x+F_ge2(x); apply a convergent Poincare-Dulac transformation x=Phi(z).
Retain resonant monomials z^mu e_j satisfying mu dot lambda=lambda_j, |mu|>=2.
For finite resonant set phi_i(z), introduce w_i=phi_i(z). Resonant closure gives xi=(z,w), xi_dot=B*xi.
Original trajectories lie on M={w_i-phi_i(z)=0}; prove invariance by Lie-derivative ideal membership.
Measure lift dimension, maximum degree, coefficient growth, conditioning and chart radius; refuse outside certified chart.

linear_stage_identity.block_system: Lcal=I_s kron W - h*gamma*A_stage kron B - gamma*C_stage kron I; W=I-h*gamma*B
linear_stage_identity.factor: Lcal=(I_s kron W)*(I-N), N=h*gamma*A_stage kron W^-1*B + gamma*C_stage kron W^-1
linear_stage_identity.nilpotence: A_stage and C_stage are strictly lower triangular, hence N^s=0
linear_stage_identity.limitation: Exact algebraic identity, not a speed result. Count power application, Krylov/multishift work, setup and memory.

acceptance: Normal-form convergence and chart assumptions justified.
Resonant monomials, parent matrix and algebraic constraints exact/source-bound.
Original-state output agrees with independent integration under transported error bound.
Lift dimension/conditioning do not erase savings.
Linear stage-block residual and estimator semantics verified separately.
transform_candidate.fallback: Refuse nonconvergent, ill-conditioned, high-dimensional or chart-exiting lifts.
